rows.Kwic: 本分事者，即當人本命元辰之落處也。

Override.AttributionNote: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xiuyelin (秀野林禪師語錄), in Xiuyelin's instruction to Layman Mengzhai Pan (示夢齋潘居士). Xiuyelin is the exact speaker who tells Pan that the fundamental matter is the landing place of the person's own root-destiny (本分事者，即當人本命元辰之落處也). The preceding old-worthy quotation ends several sentences earlier and does not speak the stored line.
